recommendations.text: Resume nutrition logging immediately. 23+ consecutive days with zero logged intake on a GLP-1 appetite suppressant. This is the single highest-leverage intervention available: protein intake almost certainly below the 1.6 g/kg floor (pre-gap average was 1.1 g/kg at best). On Wegovy, under-eating risks lean-mass loss, poor tendon recovery during the running comeback, suppressed adaptation, and depressed HRV/body battery. The weight loss rate (0.72%/wk) is healthy but without protein tracking, the composition of that loss is unmonitored.
